_comment: Weekly side quests ('chatter' at the Saloon). Each week a settlement with a Saloon rolls quests from these templates (count and loot quality come from the Saloon's chatter and tips upgrade tracks). A quest borrows its look, events and curios from the region west of the settlement, plus its own theme events (events: drawn 40%, see quest_event_weights) and scales to that region's tier. fights/elites are weighted groups; final is the group at the end when there is no boss; boss is the mini-boss group (a boss appears with boss_chance). {place} in names and text is replaced with a random place.

mad_dog.name: Mad Dog's Hideout
mad_dog.desc: Ma Delaney hears Mulligan, Silas Crane's enforcer, is holed up at {place} with his brawlers. The whole saloon wants him gone.

boss.name: "Mad Dog" Mulligan
boss.intro:
Mulligan's hideout at {place} is a sod house with a whiskey barrel for a front door. A man the size of a woodstove steps out, cracking his knuckles, a black crow feather stuck in his cap.

"You're the ones who roughed up Pete. Boys! Company!"
boss.victory: Mulligan goes down like a felled oak. When he comes to, he's hog-tied on the back of your wagon, and Ma Delaney has a Wanted poster with a reward on it.

rustlers.name: Rustlers at {place}
rustlers.desc: A rancher says rustlers are holed up at {place} with half his herd.

boss.name: The Rustler Boss
boss.intro: The rustlers' boss stands on a water barrel at {place}, a stolen brand still smoking in his hand. "Nobody told you this is my land now?"
boss.victory: The rustlers scatter into the brush, leaving the herd and everything they stole.

wolf_den.name: The Wolves of {place}
wolf_den.desc: Homesteaders near {place} are losing stock to a wolf pack that isn't afraid of anything.

boss.name: The Pack at the Den
boss.intro: The den is a cut bank at {place}, littered with bones. The whole pack comes out at once, and the biggest wolf you've ever seen leads them.
boss.victory: The pack breaks and runs. The homesteaders at {place} will sleep tonight.

haunted_homestead.name: The Haint at {place}
haunted_homestead.desc: Lights have been seen at the empty homestead at {place}. Folks say the family never left.

boss.name: The Family That Stayed
boss.intro: The door of the homestead at {place} swings open by itself. There's a table set for supper, and the family is sitting at it. They turn to look at you.
boss.victory: The lights go out one by one. Whatever held them here has let go.

claim_jumpers.name: Claim Jumpers at {place}
claim_jumpers.desc: A prospector's claim at {place} was jumped. He'll share the color if you run them off.

boss.name: The Jumpers' Foreman
boss.intro: Sticks of dynamite are stacked in the sluice at {place}, and the man guarding them is holding a lit cigar.
boss.victory: The claim at {place} is back in honest hands, and the prospector pays in color.

snake_gulch.name: Snakes in {place}
snake_gulch.desc: A wagon went into the gulch at {place} and nobody wants to go get it. Snakes.

boss.name: The Nest
boss.intro: The wagon at the bottom of {place} is alive with snakes, and something much bigger is coiled in the bed.
boss.victory: The gulch goes quiet. The wagon's cargo is still there, mostly.

crow_scouts.name: Crane's Scouts near {place}
crow_scouts.desc: Riders with black feathers have been seen watching the road from {place}. Silas Crane is keeping an eye on you.

boss.name: Crane's Scout Captain
boss.intro: The scouts' camp at {place} has a cage full of crows and a map of your whole trail pinned to a tree.
boss.victory: You burn the map and let the crows go. Silas will be a little blinder for a while.
